pages.title: Halloween Dress Up Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create six spooky outfits in Halloween Dress Up Party. Choose a witch, vampire, zombie, ghost, pumpkin, or mummy theme, then style the model with clothing, hair, makeup, accessories, and a background. Finish a look to receive the judges' stars, save it in the gallery, and unlock the next party.

pages.title: Hexa Stack
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Sort colored hexagons in Hexa Stack. Drag stacks onto the board so matching colors gather together, then build groups of at least ten identical tiles to clear them. Set up chain reactions and use swap or shuffle boosters when the space becomes crowded.

pages.title: Hero Match
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Help a superhero restore damaged landmarks in Hero Match. Swap pieces into matches of three and complete the puzzle tasks that support the rescue. Continue through the boards to oppose the villain and rebuild locations around the world.

pages.title: TapKO
pages.creator: Yes2Games
pages.description: Read your opponent's movements in TapKO. Tap on the attack or counter prompts and hold to block an incoming blow. Train the boxer between fights and use those cues to time your responses as the contests become harder.

pages.title: Grenade Simulator
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Experiment with blasts in Grenade Simulator. Throw grenades, lay mines, and trigger explosions within the sandbox. Use the available tools to set up different destructive situations and watch how each detonation affects the scene.

pages.title: School Escape: Obbie Run!
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Collect the keys and escape the building in School Escape: Obbie Run! Guide the schoolboy through the rooms while keeping ahead of the pursuing teacher. Find the exit door after gathering everything needed to unlock the route out.

pages.title: Frost Defense
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description: Defend yourself from arctic creatures in Frost Defense. Draw a route through the frozen battlefield and use defensive machines to stop the attackers. Click equipment to improve it as you prepare for the next assault.

pages.title: Catch a Fish Obby
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Collect valuable creatures in Catch a Fish Obby. Buy fish for an earning base, raid rivals' tanks, and guard your own collection against thieves. Use the separate keyboard controls for two players to move, jump, steal, sprint, and fight.

pages.title: Childcare Master Online
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Look after children in a daycare in Childcare Master Online. Respond to their needs and complete the care activities around the center. Keep the environment ready for the children as you work through the parenting tasks.

pages.title: Mind Gambit
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Leave a single peg on the board in Mind Gambit. Jump one peg over another into an empty position to remove the crossed piece. Plan the sequence without a timer so the final pegs can still be brought together.

pages.title: Noob: Saving friends
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Search for missing companions in Noob: Saving friends. Mine ores, sell the materials, and buy stronger pickaxes while completing tasks that advance the story. Improve your skills and explore new opportunities as you work toward finding and rescuing everyone.

pages.title: Pirate Paradise
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Clear pirate treasures from portals in Pirate Paradise. Drag objects into rows of three identical items to make them disappear. Empty every portal to complete a level, handling a larger assortment of objects as the puzzles progress.

pages.title: Dead Brain
pages.creator: The Abyss Brain
pages.description: Protect crops from zombies in Dead Brain. Aim and shoot at each wave, then choose a random bonus after surviving it. New weapons, healing, defense repairs, and health improvements help prepare the farmer for the next attack.

pages.title: TearDown - Destruction SandBox
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description: Dismantle buildings in TearDown - Destruction SandBox. Explore the locations and use tools ranging from a hammer to a bazooka to break structures apart. Switch equipment through the inventory and move around the site to choose another target.

pages.title: Square World 3D
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Construct your own block landscape in Square World 3D. Select materials, rotate and place blocks, or remove pieces to redesign the environment. Use flying mode to view the finished work from above and plan the next addition.

pages.title: Cat Football
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Kick a ball of blue yarn in Cat Football. Control a cap-wearing cat and score in cardboard-box goals before the match timer expires. Challenge a computer opponent or compete with a friend to finish with more goals.

pages.title: Devil Dash
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: React to changing traps in Devil Dash. Move through connected worlds, jump past hazards, and adapt when gravity or obstacles alter the route. Use WASD or the arrow keys for movement and the space bar to jump.

pages.title: Avoid The Spikes
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Bounce between walls in Avoid The Spikes. Tap to control the ball, earn points for wall contacts, and keep clear of the sharp hazards. Collect gems during the jumps and spend them on additional skins in the shop.

pages.title: Lode Retro Adventure
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect gold while evading monsters in Lode Retro Adventure. Dig holes in ground tiles to trap pursuers, then move on before they escape. Gather the required coins and bonus treasures, using the shovel to make a safer route through each level.

pages.title: 3D Moto Simulator
pages.creator: Faramel Games
pages.description: Try different motorbikes in 3D Moto Simulator. Ride around the environment with WASD and change bikes using the number keys. Compare how the available motorcycles handle as you explore and practice driving.

pages.title: Jetpack Heroes
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Fly as far as possible in Jetpack Heroes. Keep the character clear of obstacles while gathering coins, fuel, boosts, and other useful items. Use mouse or touch controls to guide the flight and extend the distance.

pages.title: Penalty Shooters 3
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Take turns shooting and saving penalties in Penalty Shooters 3. Time the power and direction of your attempts against increasingly capable computer opponents. Choose the six-tier progression or World Cup mode and customize your team's shirts as you advance.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Story
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear colorful clusters in Bubble Shooter Story. Aim each shot into a group of at least three bubbles of the same color to pop it. Remove every bubble on the board to continue through the story's puzzle levels.

pages.title: Garbage Truck Driving
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Collect refuse around town in Garbage Truck Driving. Bring the full load back to the station before the mission's timer runs out. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, change the camera with C, and use F for nitro.

pages.title: Eatventure
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Develop a fast-food business in Eatventure. Manage food preparation, staff, and deliveries so the restaurant can serve orders efficiently. Improve the operation as your earnings grow and work toward expanding the business.

pages.title: Nail Salon 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Design manicures in Nail Salon 3D. Choose polish shades and complete each customer's nail art to earn rewards. Use the proceeds to unlock more decorative stickers and try new combinations on later designs.

pages.title: MathPup Math Adventure
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Solve equations while platforming in MathPup Math Adventure. Collect numbers in the correct order to complete each problem, then fetch the key and reach the exit. Use double jumps to navigate the platforms before the level's time expires.

pages.title: Fall Boys And Girls
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Race through elimination courses in Fall Boys And Girls. Run and jump against other players to reach the goal and qualify for another round. If eliminated, watch the remaining competitors as the event continues.

pages.title: Road Painting 3D
pages.creator: Brosco Games
pages.description: Restore signs and street markings in Road Painting 3D. Select painting tools, colors, and textures, then fill the required areas carefully. Stay within the masks and outlines to improve the rating for your finished roadwork.

pages.title: Block 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Time each placement in Block 3D. Click when the moving square aligns with the block beneath it to add another piece. Watch the overlap from the three-dimensional view as you work through the stacking challenge.

pages.title: Pop Rush
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Answer percentage questions while running in Pop Rush. Gather balloons, avoid thorns, and choose answers to the trivia encountered on the course. Use your progress to pop rivals' balloons as the multiplayer race continues.

pages.title: Qawqaa
pages.creator: Sakura Games
pages.description: Help a mother rescue her daughter in Qawqaa. Tap to move, jump, and shoot while avoiding fans, spiked cubes, and collapsing bridges. Find a way through the obstacles to reach the child taken by the color-stealing cubes.

pages.title: Smiling Glass 2
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Fill the container to its target in Smiling Glass 2. Tap to release water and direct enough of it past the obstacles into the glass. Avoid spikes and other barriers that waste the flow before the required amount is reached.

pages.title: Well Sudoku
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Complete number grids in Well Sudoku. Choose one of four difficulties and fill each row, column, and box without repeating a digit. Use notes for possible values, erase a mistake, or undo a move when your reasoning changes.

pages.title: Idle Zombie Guard
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Protect computer servers in Idle Zombie Guard. Cooperate against incoming zombie waves and spend earned points on weapons, turrets, and extra health. Switch to the ice gun when fire zombies appear and keep attackers away from the equipment.

pages.title: Couple Christmas Squash Soup
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare a festive meal in Couple Christmas Squash Soup. Help Ava and Rob cook soup for their first Christmas together. Once the recipe is complete, choose holiday outfits to finish the couple's celebration.

pages.title: Hero 3 Flying Robot
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Free a captured city in Hero 3 Flying Robot. Fly through the streets and attack enemies with hand-fired energy shots, chest lasers, and homing missiles. Use vertical movement and accelerated flight to reach threats across the city.

pages.title: DOP: Delete One Part 4
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay
pages.description: Reveal a solution by erasing in DOP: Delete One Part 4. Drag across the drawing to remove the part hiding or causing the problem. Examine each scene before choosing what to erase and uncovering the result beneath it.

pages.title: Power Transmission Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Restore an electrical connection in Power Transmission Puzzle. Rotate wire sections and light bulbs until the supply reaches the lamp. Check the ends of neighboring pieces as you assemble the complete circuit.

pages.title: Orange Rope
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Thread a magnetized cord through a course in Orange Rope. Move the magnet to guide the loose end through every round object, then secure it at the destination. Longer ropes and additional objects make later routes harder to manage without tangles.

pages.title: Zoo Pong
pages.creator: Go Game Pte Ltd
pages.description: Return the ball with an animal paddle in Zoo Pong. Drag left and right and score three goals before the opponent to clear a level. Gather coins and unlock more animals while using the available power-ups during matches.

pages.title: Beach Volley
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play beach volleyball with turtles in Beach Volley. Move beneath the ball and return it over the net before it lands on your side. Beat the computer opponent by reaching ten points first.

pages.title: Missing Num Bubbles 2
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Choose the missing value in Missing Num Bubbles 2. Read the number prompt on the left and select the correct bubble from the choices. Practice identifying the number before, after, or between the given values across three modes.

pages.title: Winter Pets Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six cold-weather animal pictures in Winter Pets Puzzle. Select a scene and a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece layout. Fit the fragments together to complete the chosen pet illustration.

pages.title: Fruits Connect Float
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Connect matching fruit in Fruits Connect Float. Pair tiles through paths with at most two right-angle turns and clear the board before time ends. Watch for pieces floating in different directions as you work through twenty-seven layouts.

pages.title: Cannon Surfer
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Push a mobile weapon along a hazardous course in Cannon Surfer. Drag to steer clear of blocks and improve the tank for the boss encounter. Use the rainbow shell option when the ordinary setup needs extra help.

pages.title: Kids Vehicles Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Remember briefly revealed images in Kids Vehicles Memory. Study where the vehicle pictures appear, then select their positions after they disappear. Later levels give less time for finding the complete set, making the initial observation increasingly important.

pages.title: Fairy Tale Dragons Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Match fantasy creatures in Fairy Tale Dragons Memory. Reveal two cards at a time and remember their locations to find identical pairs. Clear four levels while trying to reduce the number of guesses you need.

pages.title: Mad Dentist
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Treat damaged teeth in Mad Dentist. Select the available dental instruments and follow the game's treatment tasks for each patient. Work through the mouth's problems to complete the appointment.

pages.title: Find These Guys
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Locate people among lookalikes in Find These Guys. Compare the faces listed on the left with the main crowd and select the matching characters. Wrong selections cost time, while zoom and hints can help with a difficult search.

pages.title: Crazy Professor Bubble
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Mix colored ingredients through bubble shots in Crazy Professor Bubble. Aim at a cluster to form at least three balls of the same color and remove it. Help the professor combine the six ingredient types while building a higher score.

pages.title: Stunt Car Challenge 3
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Take on timed driving courses in Stunt Car Challenge 3. Use the arrow keys to handle the vehicle and carry it through ramps and race sections. Complete the course quickly while keeping control of each landing and turn.

pages.title: Real Bike Racing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Set faster laps in Real Bike Racing. Ride around the tracks with steering, braking, and nitro controls while chasing improved times. Customize the rider and unlock stronger motorcycles as you progress through the racing challenges.

pages.title: shapez.io
pages.creator: Tobias Springer IT Solutions
pages.description: Build production lines in shapez.io. Extract resources and automate the creation and combination of shapes, then deliver the requested designs to unlock improvements. Expand the factory across the map as rising demand requires faster and more complicated production.

pages.title: Euro Train Simulator Game 3D
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Take control of a train in Euro Train Simulator Game 3D. Guide the engine along the railway and manage its progress through the level's driving task. Watch the route and use the train controls to reach the required destination.

pages.title: Over the Bridge
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Create a crossing for vehicles in Over the Bridge. Build a bridge spanning the gap so traffic can reach the opposite side. Judge the distance and arrange the structure before sending a vehicle across.

pages.title: Blend It 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Serve drinks from a beach shop in Blend It 3D. Combine ingredients to make different juices, then choose a glass and decorations for the order. Satisfy customers as you run the stand and work toward unlocking additional skins.

pages.title: Helix Jump 2020
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Drop through rotating platforms in Helix Jump 2020. Turn the tower to align openings beneath the ball and keep clear of the dangerous colored sections. Continue downward through the endlessly generated layout to extend the attempt.

pages.title: Fantasy Scenery Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Compare two illustrated landscapes in Fantasy Scenery Differences. Select every changed detail before the time limit runs out, earning a better score for faster work. Use the hint button when a remaining difference is hard to locate.

pages.title: DinoZ City
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Rescue captives from a dinosaur invasion in DinoZ City. Find scientists and police officers while fighting through the occupied streets. Use armored vehicles against the dinosaurs and tackle the mission alone or with a second player.

pages.title: Easter Day Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild seasonal pictures in Easter Day Slide. Choose among three images and three puzzle modes, then slide the tiles into the correct arrangement. Follow the image's details to restore the complete Easter scene.

pages.title: Intersection Chaos
pages.creator: Vedia Games
pages.description: Keep vehicles apart in Intersection Chaos. Tap a car to change its direction before it collides with traffic from another crossing. Watch the approaches together and keep the intersection moving for as long as possible.

pages.title: Jump Basket
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Time basketball jumps in Jump Basket. Use W, the up arrow, or touch controls to rise toward the ball and challenge the opposing side. Choose a solo match, local two-player contest, or online multiplayer game.

pages.title: Magical Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Clear the board with accurate shots in Magical Bubble Shooter. Drag to aim and release a bubble into a group of at least three matching colors. Remove the full formation while trying to use as few shots as possible.

pages.title: Soap Cutting
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Reveal small objects concealed inside bars in Soap Cutting. Scrape away layers of soap and break them into pieces with mouse or touch input. Continue removing the material until the hidden item is exposed.

pages.title: Hidden Heart
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search for concealed symbols in Hidden Heart. Examine the illustrated scene and click the hearts blended into its details. Keep checking the picture for the remaining heart shapes until the search is complete.

pages.title: Valentines Kisses
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare couples for a party in Valentines Kisses. Choose makeup and outfits for the royal characters before their Valentine's Day celebration. Coordinate the available clothes and colors to complete each couple's look.

pages.title: Idle Shooter
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Destroy approaching blocks with controlled balls in Idle Shooter. Swipe or move the mouse to guide your attacks and collect coins from your progress. Buy upgrades, improve the shooting statistics, and continue into higher levels.

pages.title: Street Racing 2D
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Avoid collisions on a busy road in Street Racing 2D. Steer left and right around other cars while gathering shields, health, and speed pickups. Use those bonuses to keep the vehicle moving and improve the score.

pages.title: Cartoon Dreaming Scences Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Arrange picture tiles in Cartoon Dreaming Scences Slide. Select one of three illustrations and a mode, then slide the sections into place. Use the scene's colors and outlines to guide the remaining tile movements.

pages.title: Rubber Duckie Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Make matching rows in Rubber Duckie Match 3. Arrange at least three same-colored pieces together to score and sustain the meter on the left. Keep finding combinations before that meter falls too far and ends the game.

pages.title: Clean House 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Scrub every section of a wall in Clean House 3D. Move the eraser with the keyboard or drag it with the mouse to cover the dirty surface. Check the remaining patches and finish cleaning the whole area.

pages.title: Junior Chess
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Practice moving chess pieces in Junior Chess. Guide your side across the board and use the pieces' different movement patterns to challenge the opposition. Consider how a move changes the positions available to both players.

pages.title: Precise cannon
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Time shots from a rotating weapon in Precise cannon. Collect trophies across three solo difficulties, or compete with another player while sending disadvantages to their side. Use touch controls to fire, or Z and M for a two-player keyboard match.

pages.title: Cannon Boom
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Launch between barrels in Cannon Boom. Tap to fire the ball when the next cannon is lined up with its path. Keep transferring between cannons to improve your score and unlock other ball skins.

pages.title: Swing City
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Cross an urban obstacle course in Swing City. Click to swing and move the mouse to shift sideways around signs, cars, and other hazards. Collect coins and explore secrets as you unlock more characters and rewards.

pages.title: Train Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Operate a locomotive in Train Simulator. Use W and S or the up and down arrows to accelerate and brake while completing the railway levels. Change cameras with C and sound the horn with H.

pages.title: Antique Vehicles Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore six old-fashioned vehicle pictures in Antique Vehicles Puzzle. Choose a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece puzzle before arranging the scattered parts. Look for matching details to rebuild each complete image.

pages.title: Epic City Driver
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Battle rivals on city streets in Epic City Driver. Collect power-ups that boost speed, provide shields, or attack other cars with rockets and bombs. Choose when to use them while racing toward the front of the field.

pages.title: Special Forces
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight with guns and grenades in Special Forces. Move through the action, aim down sights, crouch, or sprint to change position. Try both modes and use the weapon-selection keys as you work through the level-up progression.

pages.title: Fire Dragon Adventure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Cooperate across a fantasy world in Fire Dragon Adventure. Guide a hero and dragon around traps and monsters to collect gold and other treasures. Use their separate controls and abilities to solve puzzles, with wall jumps opening some routes.

pages.title: Line Puzzle
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Recreate outline pictures in Line Puzzle. Move the lines until they match the reference image for each stage. Compare the shapes and corners as you work through sixty different arrangements.

pages.title: Airplan IO
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Gather energy while flying around a map in Airplan IO. Steer toward available points to strengthen your plane, and stay clear of opposing aircraft. A collision with an enemy ends the attempt, so leave enough room to turn away.

pages.title: Halloween Face Art
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare Kendall, Kylie, and Gigi for a celebration in Halloween Face Art. Choose painted designs for each girl's face before the party. Try the available patterns and colors to complete their seasonal looks.

pages.title: Money Clicker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Build income with repeated taps in Money Clicker. Click the cash to earn money, then spend it on improvements. Use the growing earnings to purchase more upgrades and keep increasing the total.

pages.title: Celebrity Party
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Join a celebrity dinner gone wrong in Celebrity Party. Pick your preferred star and fight the other guests after an argument breaks out. Work through the brawl to help your chosen character overcome the opposition.

pages.title: ClassicSnake.io
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Compete with other snakes in ClassicSnake.io. Move in four directions, collect power-ups, and grow by eating opponents. Use the extra abilities to gain an advantage while avoiding being eliminated yourself.

pages.title: The Skeet Challenge
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Track moving clay targets in The Skeet Challenge. Move the scope with the arrow keys or your finger and fire at the skeets. Bring down as many as possible to improve the score.

pages.title: Twins Winter Fun!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose cold-weather outfits in Twins Winter Fun! Help a princess and her two young daughters prepare for a skiing trip. Combine the available winter clothing into a finished look for each member of the family.

pages.title: Music Submarine
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Guide an underwater vehicle to music in Music Submarine. Follow the rhythm while steering away from torpedoes along the route. Keep the submarine moving through the course and work toward a higher score.

pages.title: Rachel Sweet Candy Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare treats for an opening celebration in Rachel Sweet Candy Shop. Help Rachel finish the desserts before her friends arrive at the new store. Follow the preparation activities to get the sweets ready for the event.

pages.title: Poke Mania 2 Maze Master
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Explore winding passages in Poke Mania 2 Maze Master. Choose from five characters and guide your selection through the game's maze challenges. Study the available paths as you work through each layout.

pages.title: Greedy Gods
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Develop an island with rewards from a spinning wheel in Greedy Gods. Collect gold to build and improve the island's objects. Attack and stealing events offer further rewards, while shields help defend the work you have completed.

pages.title: Hex Get 10
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Combine numbered hexagons in Hex Get 10. Merge adjacent equal values into a higher number and keep building toward ten. Consider which neighboring groups the merge will leave available before choosing the next combination.

pages.title: Princess Donuts Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help run a dessert business in Princess Donuts Shop. Prepare doughnuts for the customers and choose their decorations. Combine candies, toppings, and fruit to finish the shop's orders.

pages.title: Viking Workout
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Practice throwing axes in Viking Workout. Move the mouse to aim and click to launch an axe toward the target. Judge the next throw carefully as you work through the game's axe-throwing tasks.
